examples.en: The company announced the acquisition of its main competitor today.
examples.zh: 该公司今天宣布收购其主要竞争对手。

examples.en: Language acquisition is a natural process for young children.
examples.zh: 语言习得对幼儿来说是一个自然的过程。

examples.en: The current profit levels will serve as a benchmark for future performance.
examples.zh: 目前的利润水平将作为未来业绩的基准。

examples.en: Our customer service is seen as the benchmark for the entire industry.
examples.zh: 我们的客户服务被视为整个行业的基准。

examples.en: We must have a contingency plan in case the negotiations fail.
examples.zh: 我们必须有一个应对谈判失败的应急计划。

examples.en: The budget includes a small fund for any unforeseen contingency.
examples.zh: 预算中包括一小笔用于任何不可预见偶发事件的资金。

examples.en: The company decided to increase its annual dividend to shareholders.
examples.zh: 公司决定增加向股东发放的年度股息。

examples.en: Investing in education will pay a huge dividend in the long run.
examples.zh: 从长远来看，投资教育将带来巨大的红利。

examples.en: She has built up a significant amount of equity in her home.
examples.zh: 她已经在她的房子里积累了大量的资产净值。

examples.en: The firm specializes in private equity investments.
examples.zh: 该事务所专门从事私募股权投资。

examples.en: Market fluctuations can affect the price of gold significantly.
examples.zh: 市场波动会显著影响黄金价格。

examples.en: The constant fluctuation in temperature made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 温度的不断波动让每个人都不舒服。

examples.en: Employees can file a formal grievance if they feel mistreated.
examples.zh: 如果员工觉得受了委屈，可以提出正式申诉。

examples.en: The committee was set up to investigate staff grievances.
examples.zh: 委员会的成立是为了调查员工的不满。

examples.en: There is a clear hierarchy within the corporate structure.
examples.zh: 公司结构内有明确的等级制度。

examples.en: She quickly rose through the hierarchy of the civil service.
examples.zh: 她很快就在公务员阶层中获得了晋升。

examples.en: The government offers tax incentives to encourage new businesses.
examples.zh: 政府提供税收激励以鼓励新企业。

examples.en: Bonus payments provide a strong incentive for staff to work harder.
examples.zh: 奖金发放为员工更努力工作提供了强有力的激励。

examples.en: At this critical juncture, we need to make a firm decision.
examples.zh: 在这个关键时刻，我们需要做出坚定的决定。

examples.en: The project is at a very delicate juncture right now.
examples.zh: 该项目目前正处于一个非常微妙的关头。

examples.en: The company has over one million dollars in total liabilities.
examples.zh: 该公司的负债总额超过一百万美元。

examples.en: His lack of experience proved to be a liability for the team.
examples.zh: 事实证明，他缺乏经验成了团队的累赘。

examples.en: The merger between the two banks was approved by regulators.
examples.zh: 两家银行的合并已获得监管机构的批准。

examples.en: The staff are worried about job security following the merger.
examples.zh: 合并后，员工们担心工作的稳定性。

examples.en: The terms of the contract are still under negotiation.
examples.zh: 合同条款仍在谈判中。

examples.en: Negotiation is an essential skill for any successful business leader.
examples.zh: 对于任何成功的商界领袖来说，谈判都是一项必不可少的技能。

examples.en: Many companies outsource their customer support to specialized firms.
examples.zh: 许多公司将客户支持外包给专业公司。

examples.en: We decided to outsource the web development project to save costs.
examples.zh: 我们决定将网络开发项目外包以节省成本。

examples.en: He manages a diverse portfolio of international stocks.
examples.zh: 他管理着一个多元化的国际股票投资组合。

examples.en: The designer presented her portfolio during the interview.
examples.zh: 设计师在面试中展示了她的作品集。

examples.en: The sales team exceeded their annual quota by ten percent.
examples.zh: 销售团队超过了年度定额的10%。

examples.en: Import quotas were imposed to protect the local industry.
examples.zh: 为了保护当地产业，实行了进口配额。

examples.en: The company reported a record increase in quarterly revenue.
examples.zh: 该公司报告季度收入创纪录增长。

examples.en: Ad revenue is the primary source of income for many websites.
examples.zh: 广告收入是许多网站的主要收入来源。

examples.en: The multinational corporation has subsidiaries in over fifty countries.
examples.zh: 这家跨国公司在五十多个国家设有子公司。

examples.en: All other issues are subsidiary to the main goal of survival.
examples.zh: 所有其他问题与生存这一主要目标相比都是次要的。

examples.en: The restaurant has a high turnover, serving hundreds of customers daily.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅的营业额很高，每天接待数百名客户。

examples.en: Low employee turnover is a sign of a healthy corporate culture.
examples.zh: 低员工流动率是健康企业文化的标志。

examples.en: All staff members are required to wear a uniform at work.
examples.zh: 所有员工在工作中都必须穿制服。

examples.en: The buildings are of a uniform height and design.
examples.zh: 这些建筑的高度和设计都是统一的。

examples.en: The university has several research affiliates across Europe.
examples.zh: 这所大学在欧洲各地有几个研究附属机构。

examples.en: He decided to affiliate his local club with the national organization.
examples.zh: 他决定将他的地方俱乐部并入国家组织。

examples.en: The company was sued for a breach of contract.
examples.zh: 该公司因违约被起诉。

examples.en: There was a security breach at the main server room.
examples.zh: 主服务器机房发生了安全违规事件。

examples.en: The salesperson earns a ten percent commission on every deal.
examples.zh: 销售员在每笔交易中赚取10%的佣金。

examples.en: A special commission was formed to investigate the incident.
examples.zh: 成立了一个特别委员会来调查这一事件。

examples.en: The government is struggling to reduce the national budget deficit.
examples.zh: 政府正努力减少国家预算赤字。

examples.en: There is a significant deficit of skilled workers in the tech sector.
examples.zh: 科技行业熟练工人的缺口很大。

examples.en: The celebrity's endorsement helped boost the brand's sales.
examples.zh: 这位名人的代言帮助提升了品牌的销售额。

examples.en: The policy received a strong endorsement from the board of directors.
examples.zh: 该政策得到了董事会的强烈赞同。

examples.en: The economic forecast suggests a slow recovery for next year.
examples.zh: 经济预测表明明年将缓慢复苏。

examples.en: Meteorologists forecast heavy rain for the weekend.
examples.zh: 气象学家预报周末有大雨。

examples.en: His father acted as a guarantor for his student loan.
examples.zh: 他的父亲担任了他的学生贷款担保人。

examples.en: A guarantor is legally responsible for the debt if the borrower fails to pay.
examples.zh: 如果借款人未支付，担保人将在法律上对债务负责。

examples.en: Investment in transport infrastructure is essential for economic growth.
examples.zh: 交通基础设施投资对经济增长至关重要。

examples.en: The city needs to upgrade its aging water infrastructure.
examples.zh: 这座城市需要升级其老化的供水基础设施。

examples.en: The scandal could jeopardize the politician's career.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻可能会危及这位政治家的职业生涯。

examples.en: Bad weather might jeopardize our plans for the outdoor event.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气可能会危及我们户外活动的计划。

examples.en: The company was forced to liquidate its assets to pay creditors.
examples.zh: 该公司被迫变现资产以支付债权人。

examples.en: Investors may choose to liquidate their positions during a market crash.
examples.zh: 投资者可能会在市场崩盘期间选择清仓。

examples.en: The government is trying to break up the telecommunications monopoly.
examples.zh: 政府正试图打破电信垄断。

examples.en: Having a monopoly allows a company to set higher prices.
examples.zh: 拥有垄断地位使公司能够设定更高的价格。

examples.en: The board has announced its official nominee for the CEO position.
examples.zh: 董事会已经宣布了首席执行官职位的正式提名人。

examples.en: Award nominees will be revealed during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 奖项提名人将在仪式期间揭晓。

examples.en: The education system needs a complete overhaul to meet modern needs.
examples.zh: 教育系统需要彻底改革以满足现代需求。

examples.en: They decided to overhaul the machinery during the holiday break.
examples.zh: 他们决定在假期休整期间对机器进行全面检修。

examples.en: The factory closure resulted in several hundred redundancies.
examples.zh: 工厂关闭导致数百人被裁员。

examples.en: The system has built-in redundancy to prevent total failure.
examples.zh: 该系统具有内置冗余以防止全面故障。

examples.en: The audit confirmed the company's long-term solvency.
examples.zh: 审计确认了公司的长期偿付能力。

examples.en: Bank regulators monitor the solvency of financial institutions.
examples.zh: 银行监管机构监控金融机构的偿付能力。

examples.en: The bank agreed to underwrite the new stock offering.
examples.zh: 银行同意承销新发行的股票。

examples.en: Insurance companies underwrite risks associated with natural disasters.
examples.zh: 保险公司承保与自然灾害相关的风险。

examples.en: There is a significant variance in the test results across different groups.
examples.zh: 不同组之间的测试结果存在显著差异。

examples.en: He requested a variance from the local zoning laws.
examples.zh: 他申请了当地分区法的变更许可。

examples.en: We buy our supplies at wholesale prices to save money.
examples.zh: 我们以批发价购买供应品以省钱。

examples.en: The company underwent wholesale changes in its management team.
examples.zh: 公司管理团队经历了大规模的人事变动。

examples.en: The new farming techniques have significantly increased the crop yield.
examples.zh: 新的耕作技术显著提高了农作物产量。

examples.en: The bond offers a high annual yield to investors.
examples.zh: 该债券向投资者提供高额的年度收益率。

examples.en: The economy has suffered from a long period of stagnation.
examples.zh: 经济遭受了长期的停滞。

examples.en: Lack of innovation can lead to career stagnation for engineers.
examples.zh: 缺乏创新会导致工程师的职业生涯停滞。
